subject: general
question: A boat covers a certain distance downstream in 6 hours and takes 8 hours to return upstream to the starting point. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let boat speed = x

Downstream speed = x + 4, Upstream speed = x − 4

Same distance ⇒ ratio of speeds = inverse of time

⇒ (x + 4) : (x − 4) = 8 : 6 = 4 : 3

⇒ 3(x + 4) = 4(x − 4)

⇒ 3x + 12 = 4x − 16 ⇒ x = 28

**∴ Answer = 28 km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream time = 6 hr, Upstream time = 8 hr

Speed of stream = 4 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let distance = D

⇒ Downstream speed = D ÷ 6

⇒ Upstream speed = D ÷ 8

⇒ Boat speed = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2

⇒ = (D/6 + D/8) ÷ 2

⇒ = (4D + 3D) ÷ 24 × 1/2

⇒ = 7D ÷ 48

⇒ Stream speed = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2

⇒ 4 = (D/6 − D/8) ÷ 2

⇒ 4 = (4D − 3D) ÷ 24 × 1/2

⇒ 4 = D ÷ 48

⇒ D = 192

⇒ Boat speed = 7D ÷ 48 = 7 × 192 ÷ 48 = 28 km/hr

**∴ Final Answer = 28 km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Boat Formula:** Boat speed = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2

**Stream Formula:** Stream speed = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2

**Exam Insight:** Use ratio method when time is given for same distance
